cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:405.title: Director of Corporate Development
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:405.description: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs. Reports to: VP, Corporate Development Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid); Salt Lake City, UT (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office); Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid); Toronto, ON (Hybrid)
responsibilities: Investment Analysis & Deal Sourcing
Build and maintain relationships with investment bankers, brokers, and advisors to generate proprietary deal flow across consumer, retail, ecommerce, and adjacent sectors.
Lead early-stage screening and high-level modeling for inbound and proprietary opportunities.
Develop and refine sector theses (e.g., omnichannel retail, outdoor and sporting goods, home, specialty consumer) and maintain active target lists.
Prepare go/no-go recommendations with clear return framing and strategic rationale for VP and senior leadership review.
Deal Leadership & Execution
Serve as deal lead on transactions from LOI through close, owning day-to-day workstreams including modeling, diligence, financing coordination, and documentation.
Lead negotiation of key commercial terms with sellers and management teams, with VP oversight on final structure decisions.
Draft and present investment committee materials including investment thesis, value-creation plan, downside scenarios, and risk/mitigant analysis.
Coordinate internal and external diligence teams (legal, accounting, tax, IT, operations) and hold them accountable to timelines and deliverable quality.
Manage lender and co-investor relationships and support financing process management.
Portfolio Value Creation & Monitoring
Partner with portfolio company operators and CSC functional leads to design and execute 100-day plans and multi-year value-creation roadmaps for newly acquired brands.
Track portfolio performance through dashboards and monthly reviews; flag variances and work with operators to course-correct.
Support initiatives across pricing and promotion, channel mix, merchandising strategy, store fleet rationalization, digital/customer acquisition, and SG&A efficiency.
Partner with CSC's AI and analytics teams to embed automation and data-driven decision-making into portfolio operations.
Evaluate and support execution of add-on acquisitions and strategic partnerships for portfolio brands.
Team Leadership & Firm Building
Manage and develop Senior Associates and Analysts on deal teams; set expectations on modeling, research, and communication quality.
Contribute to internal playbooks, templates, and investment processes that help the platform scale efficiently.
Support capital-raising efforts, including data room prep and case study development, as needed.
qualifications: 6–10 years of total professional experience, including 2+ years in investment banking, restructuring advisory, or top-tier strategy consulting and 3+ years in private equity, special situations, or principal investing.
Proven track record as a deal contributor or lead on multiple closed transactions (buyouts, corporate carve-outs, distressed or special-situations deals).
Advanced financial modeling skills: full LBOs, operating models, returns analysis, debt sizing, and capital structure optimization.
Strong command of accounting, cash flows, and credit documentation; comfortable evaluating lender viewpoints.
Solid understanding of operational drivers in consumer and retail: traffic, conversion, AOV, merchandising economics, inventory turns, store productivity, CAC, and retention.
Demonstrated ability to lead deal workstreams independently with VP-level oversight on key decisions.
Strong communication skills; comfortable engaging directly with C-level executives, lenders, and advisors.
Experience drafting investment committee materials and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Ability to manage junior team members and external advisors simultaneously across multiple live workstreams.
Ability to translate incomplete or messy data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
Willingness to travel regularly to portfolio companies, partners, and key markets.
Experience in consumer, retail, ecommerce, or multi-unit businesses.
Exposure to middle-market companies and complex situations (multi-brand platforms, operational turnarounds, cross-border operations).
MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
Familiarity with BI tools, SQL, or Python.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0ea485df-3874-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GTM Product Manager - Marketing Operations based in Mexico. This role offers the opportunity to shape the strategy and execution of marketing operations within a fast-growing, globally distributed organization. You will take ownership of complex operational challenges and translate business needs into scalable product solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help improve processes, systems, automation, and data-driven decision-making. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and a strong focus on measurable business outcomes. You will collaborate with senior leaders and experienced teams while helping drive innovation across the go-to-market organization. Success in this position requires curiosity, ownership, strong product judgment, and a practical approach to leveraging automation and AI. Own the strategy and roadmap for marketing operations products, systems, and processes, ensuring they support broader go-to-market objectives and measurable business outcomes. Partner closely with marketing, sales, operations, technology, and other cross-functional teams to identify operational challenges and develop scalable solutions. Lead initiatives that improve efficiency, automation, data quality, workflow management, and the overall effectiveness of marketing operations. Translate complex business requirements into clear product strategies, priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans. Manage and prioritize multiple projects while balancing strategic opportunities, operational needs, and evolving business priorities. Use data, customer insights, and performance metrics to evaluate initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and guide product decisions. Drive the adoption of automation and AI capabilities to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve operational performance. Lead and support a distributed team of senior professionals, providing strategic direction while empowering them to manage day-to-day execution. Collaborate with senior leadership to solve complex organizational challenges and establish scalable approaches to go-to-market operations. Requirements Proven experience in product management, marketing operations, go-to-market operations, or a closely related function within a complex organization. Experience leading strategic initiatives and solving operational challenges across cross-functional or distributed teams. Strong track record of managing products, platforms, systems, or programs designed to improve efficiency, performance, or measurable business outcomes. Experience working closely with marketing and other go-to-market functions to translate business needs into scalable solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and business insights to prioritize opportunities and make informed decisions. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, influence senior stakeholders, and align teams around a shared strategy. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively in an asynchronous and globally distributed environment. Strong product thinking, strategic judgment, ownership, and a bias toward action. Demonstrated experience using automation and AI capabilities to improve processes, workflows, or business operations. Comfort working in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and where autonomy, curiosity, and proactive decision-making are highly valued. jobgether-jobgether:lever:25f95392-c972-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django) based in United Kingdom. Join a fast-growing, international technology environment where your backend expertise will directly support a global connectivity platform. You will build and scale high-performance APIs and mission-critical microservices used by millions of travelers worldwide. The role combines hands-on backend engineering with software architecture responsibilities, particularly around operations, automation, and scalability. You will help strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, documentation, and modern development practices. Working closely with Product and QA teams, you will turn complex business requirements into resilient and maintainable solutions. Work closely with Product, QA, and other engineering stakeholders across international teams to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives, helping create efficient and scalable development and operational processes. Act as a technical reference for backend engineering and contribute strategic thinking while remaining hands-on with implementation. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend development experience , with strong expertise in Django and Django REST Framework. Advanced proficiency in Python , with a solid understanding of backend architecture and production software development. Proven experience designing and building microservices architectures and integrating complex third-party applications or ecosystems. Strong experience with unit testing and quality-first development practices, including Pytest or comparable testing frameworks. Practical experience with asynchronous programming and optimizing high-load database queries. Demonstrated ability to identify performance issues and improve application efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Strong understanding of API design, software architecture, design patterns, and maintainable code practices. Excellent professional English skills ( C1 minimum ) for effective communication in an international, distributed environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5807e6ff-220b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Security Operations, Programs based in the United States. This senior leadership role will shape security strategy across complex, international program environments. You will serve as a trusted advisor to program leaders, helping teams achieve ambitious objectives while managing operational risk responsibly. The role combines strategic planning, security operations, crisis management, risk assessment, and organizational development. You will proactively embed security into program design, investigations, survivor engagement, office expansion, and operational planning. Success means enabling mission-critical work to move forward safely rather than simply avoiding risk. You will collaborate with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders while developing security capabilities, policies, and training. The position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a mission-driven, globally connected environment. Provide strategic leadership for the global Program Security function, ensuring security is integrated into program planning, operational decision-making, and mission delivery. Serve as a trusted security advisor to senior program leaders, contributing to organizational strategy, risk management, and complex operational decisions. Lead, coach, and develop security personnel while fostering accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and a mission-enabling security culture. Provide security leadership during crises, critical incidents, and high-risk operational situations involving staff, survivors, partners, or programs. Partner with program leadership to assess emerging risks and integrate security considerations into new initiatives, program models, investigations, office expansions, and operational plans. Develop and implement security frameworks, standards, policies, protocols, governance structures, and operational guidance for challenging environments. Maintain forward visibility into program and operational changes to anticipate security requirements and strengthen organizational preparedness. Build strong relationships with program, survivor services, legal, investigations, regional security, and operational teams, acting as the primary security contact for assigned initiatives. Communicate security risks, mitigation strategies, and recommendations clearly through executive briefings, assessments, decision-support materials, and incident communications. Develop and deliver security training, workshops, briefings, coaching, and capacity-building initiatives for program teams and leaders. Conduct security risk assessments, threat analyses, operational reviews, and after-action reviews, using findings to improve security measures and program effectiveness. Monitor emerging threats and security trends, evaluate the effectiveness of existing controls, and recommend adjustments to support organizational objectives. Support travel risk management, security technology, business continuity, incident response, and continuous improvement initiatives. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in security management, criminal justice, international relations, risk management, emergency management, law enforcement, military studies, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. At least 10 years of progressive experience in security, risk management, humanitarian operations, law enforcement, military service, international development, or a related field. At least 5 years of leadership experience managing complex security operations or risk programs. Demonstrated expertise in security risk assessments, threat analysis, mitigation planning, crisis management, incident response, and business continuity. Experience supporting sensitive activities such as investigations, legal operations, survivor-centered programming, field security, or duty-of-care initiatives. Internationa

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:69fe8d.title: Sales Manager, Enterprise
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:69fe8d.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As a Manager, Enterprise Sales, you will lead and scale our enterprise sales team, driving strategic revenue growth with a consultative, customer-first approach. You will oversee complex deal cycles, coach Enterprise Account Executives, and build the motion that wins high-impact, multi-stakeholder deals in a rapidly evolving AI landscape. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives, fostering a culture of performance, strategic thinking, and collaboration - Own and guide the full enterprise sales cycle, from targeted outbound and discovery to multi-threaded navigation, negotiation, and close - Build and refine enterprise sales playbooks, qualification frameworks, and forecasting models that increase accuracy and velocity - Partner deeply with prospects to understand organizational priorities, build trust, and establish Profound as the preferred partner for AI visibility and search transformation - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Success, and Engineering to align on go-to-market strategy, unblock enterprise requirements, and deliver seamless customer experiences - Drive pipeline generation strategy and help shape top-of-funnel programs in partnership with Growth and SDR leadership - Establish enterprise sales processes, performance metrics, and best practices that ensure consistent quota attainment across the team WHO YOU ARE - A proven enterprise sales leader with experience closing large, complex SaaS deals and managing high-performing teams - Skilled in multi-threading, stakeholder alignment, and navigating procurement, legal, security review, and executive-level conversations - A strong coach who helps Account Executives sharpen discovery, messaging, deal strategy, and negotiation - Highly strategic and structured, able to build repeatable systems and scalable enterprise sales motions - Comfortable owning forecasts, running deal reviews, and driving predictable revenue outcomes - Passionate about AI and its impact on how companies search, discover, operate, and compete LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our NYC, SF, or London office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $150,000 to $200,000 before commission (NYC and SF). Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.
